I am farming rice here in Ruvuma on my own plot, almost one hectare. Money is tight, so I cannot buy much fertilizer from the shop — maybe a small bag of urea to topdress when the rice is growing, but not a lot. I keep some chickens and a few goats, so I will carry their manure to the field before planting. I save my own seed from last season like my neighbors do, and for weeds I mostly rely on my own hands and my daughter's help, though I may buy a little herbicide if the weeds get bad. My plot depends on the rains and the low-lying water, I have no pump, so no real irrigation.
